nativeReferences.meaning: Remove named _ROOT/_END helper children with >=3 underscore words; bake helper local matrix into promoted children.
Original actor loading calls CleanUpHierachy after the EMotionFX importer.
Cleanup childRow * helperRow equals helperCol * childCol after transposition.
Missing keyed P/R/S channels use MotionPart pose defaults; not serialized bindPose fields.
Read native pose+bind fields, copy pose into motion-part fallback fields without q inversion.
Native runtime blends compressed quaternion components linearly; glTF LINEAR quaternion sampling uses slerp.

limitations: Original Diego body/head geometry and skin weights are source-derived; selected idle, locomotion and fist clips are the independently audited Hero motions mapped by matching bone names.
The browser loops a selected idle motion. Original NPC schedule selection, actor transition state, multiple-motion blending, root repositioning, facial animation and AI response are not implemented.
Native quaternion interpolation and multi-set skinning use the existing Hero runtime path; complete Genome materials and lighting remain approximations.
